roots.origin: 拉丁语 certus（已定的、确切的）← cernere（分辨）
roots.core_concept: settled beyond doubt / 已经定下来、不再摇摆
roots.core_image: 钉子钉进木头，再摇也不动了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 norma（木匠的角尺）
roots.core_concept: the measuring square / 用来比对的那把尺
roots.core_image: 木匠拿角尺往木料上一靠，看它够不够方正

roots.origin: 拉丁语 testis（见证人）/ testari（作证）
roots.core_concept: to bear witness / 站出来作证
roots.core_image: 证人站到台前，说出自己亲眼看见的

roots.origin: 拉丁语 communis（共有的）← com-（一起）+ munus（职责、赠予）
roots.core_concept: held in common / 大家共有的那一份
roots.core_image: 一口井几户人家共用，谁都能来打水

concepts.core_image: 钉子钉进木头，再摇也不动了
木匠拿角尺往木料上一靠，看它够不够方正
证人站到台前，说出亲眼看见的
一口井几户人家共用，谁都能来打水

words.root_logic: certus（已定的）本身即词根，无前缀 → 已经定下不再摇摆的；也用于指明是那一个而不泛指
words.recall_hint: certus（已定的）本身即词根 → 已经定下、不再摇摆；也用来指明是那一个而不是随便哪个
words.origin: 拉丁语 certus（已定的）← cernere（分辨）
words.native_definition: having no doubt, or referring to a particular one
words.core_concept: settled so that it no longer wavers – 已经定住，不再摇摆
words.core_image: 钉子钉到底，手推它也不动
examples: I am certain he locked the door.
Certain species cannot survive here.
semantic_expansions: 确定的/肯定的：心里已经定住不摇摆
某个：已经定下是哪一个，只是不说出来。同一个'已定'，一个说信念一个说所指

words.root_logic: certain（已定的）+ -ly（副词）→ 以不容摇摆的方式 → 当然
words.native_definition: without doubt; also used to agree readily
words.core_concept: in a way that admits no doubt – 以不留疑问的方式
words.core_image: 对方话没说完就已经点头了
examples: It is certainly worth trying.
"May I sit here?" "Certainly."
semantic_expansions: 确实/无疑：以不留疑问的方式陈述
当然（应答）：不必犹豫就答应。同一个'不容摇摆'，一个用于陈述一个用于应答

words.root_logic: certain（已定的）+ -ty（名词）→ 已经定住的那个状态，或必定发生的那件事 → 确定性
words.recall_hint: certain（已定的）+ -ty → 心里定住不摇摆的那个状态；也指那件必定会发生的事
words.native_definition: the state of being sure, or something that is bound to happen
words.core_concept: the state of being settled – 已经定住、不再摇摆的那个状态
words.core_image: 结论下面画了双横线，再没有讨论的余地
examples: We cannot predict the outcome with certainty.
Death is the one certainty.
semantic_expansions: 确定性：心里定住的那个状态
必然的事：注定要发生、无从改变的那件。同一个'已定'，一个在心里一个在事上

words.root_logic: as-（ad- 的变体，朝向）+ certain（已定）→ 弄到确定为止 → 查明
words.origin: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ certus（已定的）经古法语 acertener
words.native_definition: to find out something for sure
words.core_concept: working at it until it is settled – 一直弄到它定下来为止
words.core_image: 核对了三份记录，直到能确认那个日期
examples: Police are trying to ascertain the cause.
We must ascertain whether he agrees.
semantic_expansions: 查明/弄清：一直查到它定下来
确定（动词）：使之不再摇摆。同一个'弄到已定'，一个偏过程一个偏结果

words.root_logic: norma（角尺）+ -al（…的）→ 合乎那把尺的 → 正常的
words.origin: 拉丁语 normalis：norma（木匠的角尺）
words.core_concept: matching the measuring square – 拿尺一比正好合上
words.core_image: 角尺靠上去，木料四角都是直的
examples: Her temperature is back to normal.
It is normal to feel nervous.
semantic_expansions: 正常的/通常的：拿尺一比合得上
标准的：就是那把尺本身所定的。同一个'合乎尺度'，一个说符合一个说尺度

words.root_logic: ab-（离开）+ norm（角尺）+ -al → 偏离那把尺的 → 异常的
words.origin: 拉丁语 abnormis：ab-（离开）+ norma（角尺）
words.native_definition: different from what is usual, often in a worrying way
words.core_concept: departing from the measuring square – 拿尺一比对不上
words.core_image: 角尺靠上去，木料有一角明显歪出缝
examples: The scan showed abnormal cells.
Such heat is abnormal for April.
semantic_expansions: 异常的与不正常的：都是'拿尺一比对不上'，中文两种说法同一个内核

words.root_logic: norma（角尺）本身即词根，无词缀 → 用来比对的那把尺，即通行的标准
words.origin: 拉丁语 norma（木匠的角尺）
words.native_definition: the usual or expected standard of behaviour
words.core_concept: the square everything is measured against – 大家拿来比对的那把尺
words.core_image: 工地上人人手边都有同一把角尺，谁做的都要靠它比一比
examples: Working late became the norm there.
Social norms vary between cultures.
semantic_expansions: 规范/准则：大家拿来比对的那把尺
常态：合乎那把尺的通常状况。同一个'比对之尺'，一个是尺一个是尺下的常况

words.root_logic: normal（合乎尺的）+ -ization（使成为…的过程）→ 使之回到尺内的过程 → 正常化
words.origin: 拉丁语 normalis（合乎角尺的）+ -ization
words.native_definition: the process of making something normal or standard again
words.core_concept: bringing something back within the square – 把偏出去的弄回尺内
words.core_image: 歪掉的门框被撬正，角尺靠上去又合得上了
examples: The normalization of relations took years.
Data normalization improves comparison.
semantic_expansions: 正常化：把偏出去的弄回尺内
标准化：使各处都照同一把尺。同一个'回到尺内'，一个说恢复一个说统一

words.root_logic: testis（见证、检验）本身即词根，无词缀 → 让事物自己作证，看它到底如何
words.recall_hint: testis（见证、检验）本身即词根 → 摆出条件让事物自己作证，看它究竟如何
words.origin: 拉丁语 testum（陶钵，古时用于试炼金属）← testis（见证）
words.native_definition: a procedure to find out how good, true, or able something is
words.core_concept: putting something in a position to show what it is – 摆出条件让它自己显出真相
words.core_image: 把金属放进钵里烧，是真是假自己显出来
examples: The blood test came back clear.
She failed her driving test.
semantic_expansions: 测试/检验：摆出条件让事物自己显出真相
考试：让人自己显出会不会。同一个'让它自证'，对象是物还是人

words.root_logic: testi（见证人）+ -fy（使成为）→ 站出来充当见证 → 作证
words.origin: 拉丁语 testificari：testis（见证人）+ facere（做）
words.native_definition: to give evidence in court, or to serve as proof of something
words.core_concept: standing forth as a witness – 站出来充当见证
words.core_image: 证人席上举手，说出自己亲眼看见的
examples: She refused to testify against him.
The scars testify to years of work.
semantic_expansions: 作证（法庭）：人站出来充当见证
证明/表明（物）：某物本身充当了见证。同一个'充当见证'，见证者是人还是物

words.root_logic: con-（一起、相对）+ test（作证）→ 双方各自举证相争 → 竞赛；作动词是提出异议 → 争辩
words.recall_hint: con-（相对）+ test（作证）→ 双方各自举证相争；名词是那场较量，动词是提出异议
words.origin: 拉丁语 contestari：com-（一起）+ testari（作证）——原指'传唤双方作证以起诉'
words.native_definition: a competition, or to argue that something is wrong
words.core_concept: two sides each bringing witness against the other – 双方各自举证相争
words.core_image: 两边各摆出自己的证据，让人评谁站得住
examples: She won the singing contest.
He contested the result in court.
semantic_expansions: 竞赛/争夺：双方各出所长相争
争辩（动词）：举出反证提出异议。同一个'相对举证'，一个在赛场一个在辩场

words.root_logic: pro-（当众、向前）+ test（作证）→ 当众声明自己不同意 → 抗议
words.origin: 拉丁语 protestari：pro-（向前）+ testari（作证）
words.native_definition: to express strong disagreement, especially publicly
words.core_concept: declaring one's objection before all – 当众把不同意声明出来
words.core_image: 举着牌子站在门口，让所有路过的人都看见那句话
examples: Thousands protested against the new law.
He protested that he had not been told.
semantic_expansions: 抗议/反对：当众声明不同意
申辩：当众声明事实并非如此。同一个'当众作证'，一个反对处置一个陈述实情

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ mun（共有、职责）+ -icate → 使某物成为双方共有的 → 沟通
words.origin: 拉丁语 communicare：communis（共有的）← com-（一起）+ munus（职责、赠予）
words.native_definition: to share information so that it is understood
words.core_concept: making something held in common – 使某样东西变成双方共有
words.core_image: 同一份消息在两人脑中都有了，内容一致
examples: Good managers communicate clearly.
The disease is communicated by touch.
semantic_expansions: 沟通/传达：使信息成为双方共有
传染：使病成为双方共有。同一个'化为共有'，共有的是消息还是病

words.root_logic: communicate（化为共有）+ -ion（名词）→ 使之共有这件事，或所传之物 → 交流
words.native_definition: the exchange of information, or a message sent
words.core_concept: the making of something common between people – 使信息成为共有这件事
words.core_image: 两条线路接通，一头说话另一头同时听见
examples: Communication between departments broke down.
We received your communication yesterday.
semantic_expansions: 交流/通信：使信息成为共有这件事
信件（正式）：所传的那份东西。同一个'化为共有'，一个是过程一个是所传之物

words.root_logic: com-（一起）+ mun（共有）+ -ity（名词）→ 有共同之物的那群人 → 社区
words.native_definition: a group of people living in one place or sharing something in common
words.core_concept: people holding something in common – 共有某样东西的那群人
words.core_image: 同一片街区的人共用一口井、一条路
examples: The community raised funds for the school.
She belongs to the research community.
semantic_expansions: 社区：共用同一片地方的人
群体/共同体：共有某样东西的人。同一个'有共同之物'，共有的是地方还是志趣

words.root_logic: commun（共有的）+ -ism（主张）→ 主张财产共有的那套学说 → 共产主义
words.native_definition: a political system in which property is owned collectively
words.core_concept: the doctrine that things be held in common – 主张财物共有的那套学说
words.core_image: 田地不写谁的名字，收成按人分
examples: The book traces the rise of communism.
He studied the economics of communism.
